title: 2731. Movement of Robots

examples.explanation: After 1 second, the positions are [-1,-1,1]. Now, the robot at index 0 will move left, and the robot at index 1 will move right. After 2 seconds, the positions are [-2,0,0]. Now, the robot at index 1 will move left, and the robot at index 2 will move right. After 3 seconds, the positions are [-3,-1,1]. The distance between the robot at index 0 and 1 is abs(-3 - (-1)) = 2. The distance between the robot at index 0 and 2 is abs(-3 - 1) = 4. The distance between the robot at index 1 and 2 is abs(-1 - 1) = 2. The sum of the pairs of all distances = 2 + 4 + 2 = 8.
After 1 second, the positions are [2,-1]. After 2 seconds, the positions are [3,-2]. The distance between the two robots is abs(-2 - 3) = 5.
